name: 18-capability-menu
teaches: capabilities/list answers what a deployment wired and what THIS instance may reach, in the C host's shape. It is gated on its own capability, so an auditor granted that and nothing else can report a swarm's whole reach while holding none of it.
cmd: echo '$ drt run --config auditor.json'; drt run --config auditor.json; echo; echo '$ drt run --config worker.json'; drt run --config worker.json; echo; echo '$ drt run --config ungranted.json'; drt run --config ungranted.json; echo "exit $?"
